subject_uz: Bulung'ur tumanidagi 17 ga pista bog'ida tomchilatib sug'orish tizimini qurish (40 kVt quyosh panellari bilan)

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik topshiriq, loyiha-smeta va ekspertiza xulosasi hujjatlariga muvofiq tomchilatib sug'orish tizimi va quyosh stansiyasini qurish.
requirements.summary_en: Build the drip irrigation system and solar plant according to the technical assignment, design-estimate and expert opinion documents.
requirements.quote: uchun texnik topshiriq, loyiha-smeta va ekspertiza xulosasi hujjatlari

requirements.summary_uz: Barcha material va uskunalar (quvur, nasos, panel, inverter, kabel, avtomatika) davlat standartlariga javob berishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: All materials and equipment (pipes, pumps, panels, inverters, cables, automation) must meet state standards.
requirements.quote: Barcha materiallar va uskunalar (PE quvurlar, nasoslar, quyosh panellari, invertorlar, kabellar va avtomatika vositalari) davlat standartlariga javob berishi

requirements.summary_uz: Shunga o'xshash loyihalar tajribasi: 3 va undan ortiq loyiha uchun 15 ball, 1 ta uchun 5 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Experience with similar projects: 15 points for 3 or more, 5 points for one.
requirements.quote: 3 ta va undan ortiq shunga o'xshash loyiha bajarilgan - 15 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Malakali mutaxassislar soni: 5 nafar va undan ortiq bo'lsa 10 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Qualified specialists: 10 points for five or more.
requirements.quote: 5 nafar va undan ortiq malakali mutaxassis - 10 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Texnika o'ziga tegishli bo'lsa 10 ball, hammasi ijaraga olingan bo'lsa 5 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Equipment fully owned earns 10 points; fully leased earns 5 points.
requirements.quote: Barcha texnika va mexanizmlar ijaraga olingan. = 5.0

requirements.summary_uz: Suv xo'jaligi vazirligining Tomchi reyestrida ro'yxatdan o'tganlik uchun 10 ball.
requirements.summary_en: 10 points for registration on the Water Ministry's Tomchi register.

requirements.summary_uz: Obyekt rasmlari ilova qilingan ko'zdan kechirish ma'lumotnomasi uchun 15 ball.
requirements.summary_en: 15 points for a site-inspection certificate with photos of the site.
requirements.quote: Shaklga mos holda mavjud (Obyekt rasmlari ilova qilinsa)

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnomani bajarish uchun zarur texnik, moliyaviy, moddiy va kadrlar resurslari mavjud bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must have the technical, financial, material and staff resources needed to perform the contract.
requirements.quote: Шартномани бажариш учун зарур техник, молиявий, моддий, кадрлар ресурсларининг ҳамда бошқа ресурсларнинг мавжудлиги.

requirements.summary_uz: Soliq va yig'imlar bo'yicha muddati o'tgan qarzdorlik bo'lmasligi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: No overdue tax or fee debt.
requirements.quote: Солиқлар ва йиғимларни тўлаш бўйича муддати ўтган қарздорликнинг мавжуд эмаслиги.

documents_needed_uz: Shunga o'xshash loyihalarni bajarish tajribasi to'g'risidagi hujjatlar
Malakali muhandis-texnik va ishchi xodimlar mavjudligi to'g'risida ma'lumot
Moddiy-texnik baza (maxsus texnika va mexanizmlar) mavjudligi to'g'risida ma'lumot
Tomchi reyestrida ro'yxatdan o'tganlik to'g'risida ma'lumot
Kafolat muddati va servis xizmati to'g'risida hujjat
Obyektni ko'zdan kechirganlik to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma (obyekt rasmlari bilan)
Soliq qarzdorligi yo'qligi va insofsiz ijrochilar reyestrida qayd etilmaganligi to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma
